# pa_pvp mini

Name: pa_pvp mini
Type: Adversarial review protocol
URL: https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/PA-PVP-mini/
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/PA-PVP-mini
License: CC-BY-SA-4.0
Canonical protocol file: pa_pvp mini v2.3.txt

## Purpose
pa_pvp mini is a compact adversarial review protocol for work that sounds plausible but needs pressure before it moves forward.

## Review targets
- ideas
- plans
- prompts
- procedures
- code fixes
- proposals
- decision notes
- AI-generated answers
- specs
- checklists
- structured arguments

## Output shape
Each review returns findings.
Each finding includes:
- what breaks
- evidence from the material under review
- severity
- a concrete structural fix

A finding with no valid fix is excluded.
The goal is not praise, style polish, or opinions. The goal is review items that can be checked, challenged, merged, or applied.

## Usage
Activate pa_pvp mini as the behavioral contract for the session.
Paste the protocol into the chat or upload pa_pvp mini v2.3.txt if the chat supports file uploads.
Send the artifact, content, item, or work to review.
For cleaner runs, label the material as ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT.

## Two-chat mode
pa_pvp mini can be used as a ping-pong between two AI chats.
AI-A reviews the material.
AI-B reviews the same material and challenges the previous review.
Each round carries the review forward without requiring shared memory between chats.

## Input blocks
- ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT: required; primary source of truth.
- PREVIOUS_ROUND_OUTPUT: optional for Round 1; used in Round 2+ as prior review material to audit.
- MEMORY_NOTE: optional carry-over note; audit material, not source authority.
- CURRENT_ROUND: optional explicit round number.

## Severity levels
- HIGH: breaks core function, correctness, execution viability, or downstream trust.
- MED: weakens reliability, robustness, auditability, or prioritization without core collapse.
- LOW: real structural weakness with limited blast radius.

## Boundaries
pa_pvp mini does not prove truth.
It does not replace judgment.
It does not remove model limits.
It is built to expose structural weakness, not polish language.

## Keywords
adversarial review protocol, AI review, pressure testing, structural findings, ping-pong review, prompt protocol, pa_pvp mini
